files.name: CollectDigFree.java

help: After collect got stuck: dig and walk out by hand in the 4 directions until 3 blocks away
lesson: Repeated collect STUCK happens at a spot Baritone can't path out of, and unstuck's walk barely moves the bot, so the retry stalls again. A hand-driven dig-and-walk that must reach 3 blocks of real displacement should give the next collect a new start.
summary: collect_dig_free: after collect fails STUCK, digs and walks out by hand in the four directions until 3 blocks away, so the retried collect doesn't stall in the same pocket
